name: bvt-skills
description: Free Claude skills and plugins from the BitVault team: 133 skills in 9 plugins. Multilingual apps, token saving, iPhone and Mac apps with no Mac, crypto exchange, wallet, smart contract and chain playbooks, and loaders for 40+ popular open-source skill packs.

plugins.name: bvt-multi-language
plugins.description: BVT Multi Language: adds a language switcher and a full multilingual system to any website or app, translates it into as many languages as possible, and checks quality before release.

plugins.name: bvt-save-token
plugins.description: Use fewer tokens: short replies, diff-only code, chat handoff notes and a setup audit.

plugins.name: bvt-crypto-architecture
plugins.description: 19 architecture playbooks for crypto exchanges, wallets and token platforms: matching engine, market data, trading API, liquidity, ledger, custody, deposits, fiat ramps, India VASP rules, stablecoins, oracles, bridges, wrapped tokens, mining pools, explorers and indexing.

plugins.name: bvt-i18n-playbooks
plugins.description: 15 localization playbooks for crypto apps: i18n architecture, ICU messages, RTL, fonts, number, currency and date formats, seed phrase language rules, store listings, regulatory translation, AI translation QA and testing.

plugins.name: bvt-app-playbooks
plugins.description: 29 engineering playbooks for crypto wallet and exchange apps on mobile, desktop, web and browser extension: secure storage, biometrics, seed phrase UX, RPC resilience, React Native and Expo, Tauri, PWA, testing, store release and more.

plugins.name: bvt-chain-ops
plugins.description: 9 blockchain operations playbooks: Solidity standard, multisig plus timelock governance, PoW L1 and Besu Clique operations, chain relaunch, edge ops, incident runbooks, repo hygiene and project documentation rules.

plugins.name: bvt-smart-contracts
plugins.description: 7 smart contract and wallet-connection playbooks: ethers v6, safe upgrades, EVM storage surgery, pre-audit checklist, dapp connectivity (EIP-6963, WalletConnect), MetaMask fixes and Manifest V3 extension limits.

plugins.name: bvt-apple-builder
plugins.description: Build, sign and ship iPhone, iPad and Mac apps with no Mac: Claude writes the code and build files, a cloud Mac builds them, Claude reads the build log and fixes errors. Expo, Tauri, Flutter and SwiftUI.

plugins.name: bvt-skill-loaders
plugins.description: 43 loaders for popular open-source skill packs (Firecrawl, PostHog, Composio, gstack, Ponytail, Three.js, Blender, GSAP, Expo, Firebase, OpenZeppelin, Trail of Bits and more), each pinned to a reviewed commit, plus Openverse sound search.
